memory.hard_constraint_metric: max(absolute process RSS peak, absolute MPS driver allocation peak)

combined.boundary_convention: lossless separately tokenized prompt and answer spans

heldout_text.first_token_conditioning: tokenizer BOS, EOS, or padding seed token
heldout_text.windowing_rule: fixed target stride with maximum available left context; each target token and represented byte scored once

pristine_model_placement.mathematical_role: disk-backed restart source with one live training object

task_stream_properties.chance_level_definition: uniform random choice over distinct targets present in the test split; descriptive only and most relevant when the target set is small
task_stream_properties.template_signature_definition: exact prompt/target pair after replacing a generated Python function identifier with <function_name> when one is present

tokenizer_fitness.non_nfc_input_cost: canonically equivalent non-NFC input is normalized and its original code-point sequence is not preserved
tokenizer_fitness.roundtrip_contract: configured samples round-trip after NFC normalization and every stored task-stream prompt, target, and training target round-trips exactly
